name: @rhythmjs/cron
description: Bun-native cron for Rhythm: a pipeline of named jobs scheduled with Bun.cron, with Rhythm middleware around every run, start/stop tied to the app's lifecycle, and no scheduler of its own.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/rhythm-cron.ts --outdir dist --root src --format esm --target bun --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
